title: Carol M NDE 6496
content: When I was 10 years old, I had gone swimming with my older cousin, Karen. I was in the pool when somebody accidentally hit me on the head. I struggled to get up out of the water, but I couldn’t. I couldn’t breathe, but I only struggled for a few minutes. Then I began to drift off, feeling extremely peaceful. It wasn’t just my body that was drifting off, it was my mind too. I was no longer attached to my body (or didn't seem to be), but I was still very much ‘me.’ The best way I can describe it is that I went to a different dimension. It was totally black there. Although I was in complete darkness, I was not afraid. Instead, I felt a peace that I believe is unattainable here on earth. The next thing that happened was my whole life flashed before me. It was as if I was standing there watching a panoramic view of every single thing that had happened in my short life. The life review went by very quickly. In fact, it seemed like it was all at once. Yet I could totally comprehend every single scene as if I were living it all over again. I felt guilty for the selfish things I had done. After the life review, I turned around, and as I did, I saw a brilliant white light. Instinctively, I started to move toward it. But suddenly, I was yanked back into my body. My older cousin who had pulled me out of the water had saved me. I did NOT want to come back. I wanted to stay there. On the way home, I told my cousin what happened, and she looked at me as if I were crazy. When I got home, I repeated my story to my grandmother, who was raising me, and I got the same reaction.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Suddenly "yanked back" into her body after moving toward the brilliant white light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit on the head while swimming; unable to breathe and began to drift off in the pool.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like separation into total blackness/void, then life review, then brilliant white light, then abrupt return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer reports entering a totally black 'different dimension' with profound peace before a panoramic life review, then seeing a brilliant white light and being abruptly 'yanked back' into the body.
